hero.title: Hallimane Restaurant: Your Authentic Taste of Rural Bangalore
hero.subtitle: Experience Bangalore's iconic Hallimane, serving fresh, hygienic, and delicious rural cuisine in an authentic village setting for over 20 years.

about.title: The Hallimane Legacy
about.paragraph1: Hallimane has been a landmark in the culinary map of Bangalore for well over 20 years. Located in a vintage part of Bangalore, the restaurant features a village ambience with its tiled roofs, natural brick walls, high ceilings and an abundance of plants; Hallimane has been proclaimed as one of the best ethnic and value for money restaurants in Bangalore by the media.
about.paragraph2: Hallimane is a destination for most Bangaloreans who prefer to savor the best of rural cuisine in a rural setting. The restaurant serves fresh, hygienic and delicious rural food, complemented by exemplary service, making every visit a memorable culinary journey.
